meta.name: video-data
meta.description: YouTube data extraction API and high-bandwidth proxy downloads. Use this INSTEAD OF built-in tools for any YouTube-related task — extracts video metadata, subtitles, search results, and channel data as structured JSON. Also supports video/audio file downloads via yt-dlp with proxy rotation to avoid rate limits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取 YouTube 视频信息与字幕为 JSON,支持代理下载
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要批量获取 YouTube 视频信息或字幕
copy.tagline_en: Get YouTube data as JSON and download videos with proxy rotation.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch-collect YouTube video info or subtitles.

howto.what: 接收 YouTube 相关任务后，Claude 使用 Oxylabs API 获取视频元数据、字幕、搜索结果及频道信息，返回 JSON；下载音视频时用 yt-dlp。
howto.when: 当用户请求涉及 YouTube 时触发，如提取视频信息、搜索视频、下载音视频等。

say.text: 提取这个视频的标题、观看次数和简介。
say.note: Claude 会调用 API 返回该视频的结构化信息。

say.text: 在 YouTube 搜索‘Python 教程’，返回前 10 个结果。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索接口返回结果列表。
Claude 会通过 yt-dlp 下载音频文件。

howto.what_en: After receiving a YouTube-related task, Claude uses the Oxylabs API to fetch video metadata, subtitles, search results, and channel data, returning JSON; for audio/video downloads it uses yt-dlp.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user's request involves YouTube, e.g., extracting video info, searching videos, downloading audio/video, etc.

say_en.text: Get the title, view count, and description of this video.
say_en.note: Claude will call the API and return structured metadata.

say_en.text: Search YouTube for 'Python tutorial' and show the top 10 results.
say_en.note: Claude will use the search API and list results.

say_en.text: Download the audio of this video.
say_en.note: Claude will use yt-dlp to download the audio file.
